mechanism: Dorzolamide may cause systemic absorption leading to metabolic acidosis and hypokalemia, while fluphenazine can potentiate CNS depression and increase risk of anticholinergic effects; both drugs can affect electrolyte balance and cardiac conduction.
action: Monitor serum electrolytes (particularly potassium), blood pH, and cardiac function; assess for increased CNS depression and anticholinergic symptoms during concurrent use.
